group.title: AccountingGroup
group.description: Chart-of-accounts classification group under which ledgers are organised (e.g. Bank Accounts, Investments, Direct Expenses)

name.description: Group name (e.g. Cash-in-Hand, Bank Accounts, Direct Expenses)

parentGroup.description: Optional parent group for hierarchy (e.g. Current Assets)

isSystemGroup.description: System-defined group seeded from defaults; user groups are false

category.description: Fundamental accounting category the group rolls up into

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: An accounting ledger account under a primary group (e.g. Bank, Cash, Expenses, Income, Investments)

name.description: Account name (e.g. HDFC Bank, Husband's Wallet, Grocery Expenses, Salary Income)

budgetAmount.description: Optional monthly budget limit for variance warning

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

voucher.title: Voucher
voucher.description: Double-entry accounting transaction voucher (F4 Contra, F5 Payment, F6 Receipt, F7 Journal)

entriesJson.description: JSON serialized list of Dr and Cr line items

paymentMode.description: Payment mode e.g. UPI, CASH, BANK, CARD

familyMember.description: Family member who spent or received

attachmentUri.description: Optional local or cloud receipt image attachment URI

isSplit.description: Whether this transaction was split among family members

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Monthly budget limit for a specific ledger category

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

recurring_voucher.title: RecurringVoucher
recurring_voucher.description: Scheduled or repeating recurring voucher entry template

title.description: Description of the recurring transaction (e.g. Monthly Rent, SIP Investment, Netflix)

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

family_member.title: FamilyMember
family_member.description: Registered family member profile for role-based permissions and tagging

name.description: Member display name (e.g. Papa, Mummy, Self, Kid)

role.description: Role: Admin can edit masters & view all reports, Member can enter expenses

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/groups/{groupId}.description: Accounting classification groups scoped per user

/users/{userId}/ledgers/{ledgerId}.description: Accounting ledger accounts scoped per user

/users/{userId}/vouchers/{voucherId}.description: Transaction vouchers (Contra, Payment, Receipt, Journal) scoped per user

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Monthly spending budgets and variance limits

/users/{userId}/family_members/{memberId.description: Family members for role tracking and expense splitting
